problems.title: Read the gradient
problems.scenario: What is the gradient of the line $y = 3x + 2$?
problems.solution: In $y = mx + c$ the gradient is $m$, the coefficient of $x$. Here $m = 3$ (and the intercept $c = 2$).

problems.title: Linear with brackets
hints: Divide both sides by 2 first (or expand).
problems.solution:
Divide by 2, then subtract 3:

$$2(x+3) = 14 \;\Rightarrow\; x + 3 = 7 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 4$$

problems.title: Simultaneous by elimination
problems.scenario:
Solve the pair and give $x$:

$$x + y = 10, \qquad x - y = 4$$
hints: Add the two equations — the $y$ cancels.
problems.solution:
Add the equations so $y$ cancels:

$$(x+y) + (x-y) = 10 + 4 \;\Rightarrow\; 2x = 14 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 7$$

(Then $y = 3$.)

problems.title: Find the intercept
problems.scenario: A line $y = mx + c$ has gradient $m = 3$ and passes through the point where $x = 2$, $y = 11$. Find $c$.
problems.solution:
Put the known values into $y = mx + c$:

$$11 = 3(2) + c \;\Rightarrow\; 11 = 6 + c \;\Rightarrow\; c = 5$$

problems.title: Simultaneous by substitution
problems.solution:
Substitute the first into the second:

$$x + 2x = 12 \;\Rightarrow\; 3x = 12 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 4$$

(Then $y = 8$.)

problems.title: Elimination by subtraction
problems.scenario:
Solve and give $x$:

$$2x + y = 7, \qquad x + y = 5$$
hints: Subtract the second equation from the first — $y$ cancels.
problems.solution:
Subtract to cancel $y$ (equal coefficients):

$$(2x + y) - (x + y) = 7 - 5 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 2$$

(Then $y = 3$.)

problems.title: Mixed simultaneous
problems.solution:
Rearrange the second and substitute:

$$x = y + 2 \;\Rightarrow\; 3(y+2) + 2y = 16 \;\Rightarrow\; 5y + 6 = 16 \;\Rightarrow\; y = 2$$
$$x = y + 2 = 4$$

problems.title: Solve a pair fully
problems.scenario:
Solve simultaneously for $x$ and $y$:

$$x + y = 5, \qquad 2x - y = 4$$
problems.solution:
Add to eliminate $y$:

$$(x+y) + (2x-y) = 5 + 4 \;\Rightarrow\; 3x = 9 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 3$$
$$y = 5 - x = 2$$

So $x = 3,\; y = 2$. Check: $2(3) - 2 = 4$ ✓.

problems.title: Elimination with scaling
hints: The $y$ terms are already equal-and-opposite — add the equations.
problems.solution:
Add the equations so $2y$ and $-2y$ cancel:

$$(5x + 2y) + (3x - 2y) = 24 + 0 \;\Rightarrow\; 8x = 24 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 3$$

(Then $3(3) = 2y \Rightarrow y = 4.5$.)

problems.title: Two-item word problem
problems.scenario:
Two quantities $a$ and $b$ satisfy:

$$2a + b = 8, \qquad a + 2b = 7$$

Find $a$.
hints: From the first, $b = 8 - 2a$. Substitute into the second.
problems.solution:
Substitute $b = 8 - 2a$ into the second equation:

$$a + 2(8 - 2a) = 7 \;\Rightarrow\; a + 16 - 4a = 7 \;\Rightarrow\; -3a = -9 \;\Rightarrow\; a = 3$$

(Then $b = 8 - 6 = 2$.)
